points.form: んばかりに / の / だ
points.formation: Negative verb stem without ない + んばかり; する → せん. に attaches to an action, の to a noun, だ predicates an appearance.
points.teachingChoice: Expressive description is not proof of an audible quotation. Hana/Ren discuss a literary draft; ordinary chat stays conversational. Avoid hard universal bans on first-person retrospective description.

points.formation: Obstacle noun + をものともせず（に） + action continued despite it.
points.teachingChoice: Determined/admirative narrative tone. The later clauses establish concrete action and result. Do not adopt universal third-person-only, life-threatening-obstacle or inevitable-success claims.

points.form: ならではの / ならではだ
points.formation: Noun + ならではの + valued quality; noun + ならではだ where the quality is identified.
points.teachingChoice: Usually appreciative distinctiveness in a specific material/person/context; a subjective compliment is not independent factual proof of cultural or material exclusivity.

points.formation: Minimal quantity / one plus counter + たりとも + negative or prohibition.
points.teachingChoice: Strong formal/emphatic exclusion of even one unit. Identify the document covered by the vow; father’s letter and Hana’s new draft are distinct. Do not confuse with action-listing たり…たり.
